name: PageScrollbar
summary: The page's own scrollbar drawn as ScrollArea's bar at a placed edge (LR156): while it's mounted the window still scrolls the page (headers, anchors, find in page and scroll-linked motion keep reading it), the browser's root bar is hidden, and this bar, the same thumb, drag and track paging as every ScrollArea, follows the document at `insetInlineEnd` from the window's end edge. For an app that docks a pane over the page's end edge (a review or inspector pane) so the page's bar sits at the pane's start edge instead of under it. Unmounting brings the root bar back.
a11y: The drawn bar is hidden from assistive technology and out of the tab order: it repeats the page's own scrolling, which keeps every key. Forced colours and touch screens keep the system's own root bar and draw none.

props.name: mode
props.description: `always` (default) shows the bar whenever the page overflows; `auto` shows it while scrolling, on hover and while it's dragged.

props.name: insetInlineEnd
props.description: How far the bar sits from the window's end edge, a CSS length (e.g. a docked pane's width, `var(--dock-width)`). Default 0: at the window's edge.

props.name: insetBlockStart
props.description: Room kept above the bar, a CSS length (a fixed bar over the page's top). Default 0.

props.name: insetBlockEnd
props.description: Room kept under the bar, a CSS length (a docked tray at the window's foot). Default 0.
